_doc: Seed sources for the drum reviewer, best first. A track opens from its human file (edm/drums_human/) if there is one, else from the first source below that has a file for it (and isn't marked skipped). Each source is one directory under edm/ of kick_weighted-schema files: {"onsets": [{"time": s, "type": "kick"|"snare"|"hihat"|...}]}. To add a better seed (e.g. drums after source separation), add its directory and put its entry first. labelcheck.py reads this file too: the counts check compares against every source listed here.

seeds.name: kick_weighted
seeds.label: band detector (known bad)
seeds.warning: Seeded from kick_weighted: band-detector labels, known bad (e.g. most snares labelled kicks). Check every hit.

_doc_references: Reference-only label sets: the page offers them under Settings > Reference ticks as ghost ticks, but they never seed a track and the label checks don't compare against them. Same entry format as a seed.
